name: Rairaiken
description: The first specialised ramen shop, traced to Asakusa in 1910. The original closed in 1976; Wikipedia reports a descendant of the founder reopened it in Asakusa in 2026.
review_body: Ramen historians trace the first specialised ramen shop, Rairaiken, to Asakusa in 1910. The original closed in 1976, and Wikipedia reports a descendant of the founder reopened it in Asakusa in 2026.
